facts.fact: The Centre de calcul El Khawarizmi began a test period on 23 July 2026 for a new high-performance computing system funded by a Chinese grant of USD 10.6 million (TND 32 million), with service planned in the coming months after more than three months of testing and training; the minister lists artificial intelligence among its uses.
